name: EURC
oneLiner: EURC is Circle's centralized euro stablecoin, redeemable 1:1 by qualifying customers and backed by cash and short-term assets denominated in euros.
collateral: Euro-denominated fiat reserves held separately from Circle operating funds at regulated financial institutions in the EEA
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 redemption through Circle Internet Financial Europe SAS (licensed EMI under MiCA); Circle Mint enables institutional mint/redeem at zero fees with near-instant settlement

applicabilityBasis.summary: EURC is a euro-referenced Circle stablecoin issued as a MiCA e-money token by Circle Internet Financial Europe SAS with 1:1 euro redemption and monthly reserve attestations.

genius.notes: EURC is payment-stablecoin-like, but its issuer is Circle Europe under MiCA/ACPR rather than Circle Internet Financial, LLC. No U.S. GENIUS PPSI approval, OCC foreign-issuer registration, or Treasury comparability determination was found for EURC/Circle Europe.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At the exact cutoff, the Ethereum, Base, Avalanche, World Chain, and Cronos FiatTokenV2_2 deployments exposed live blacklister roles at 0x601c97ed567253bf09a51998d53c5aa73290bd73, 0x8415c913a925586b5169b0322f6ead8f5c9a1ead, 0x3a1ea44b838a771fed2f81137d772c47a64f5d40, 0xa5af94a3935a088ec2da7ae500fc13cda0e83362, and 0xeae603121f38d43e801254d172fd0bee959918b6 respectively; each token owner can also replace its blacklister. Solana retained 2-of-4 freeze authority 6FF2CPcL6fat16QVJH6W27DeBcX7TSqbwY3a5wtyVJLC, and the 2-of-4 Stellar issuer retained AUTH_REVOCABLE. These are direct on-chain blacklist or equivalent freeze controls.

mintAuthority.summary: EURC has seven independently mintable native deployments. Ethereum, Base, Avalanche, World Chain, and Cronos use Circle FiatTokenV2_2 custom proxies with chain-local MasterMinter, token-owner, and proxy-admin controls. Solana and Stellar each use a 2-of-4 issuer multisig. Every EVM mint or upgrade path has zero on-chain delay and a code-empty single-account authority; off-chain custody behind those accounts is unknown.

controls.label: Ethereum EURC MasterMinter
controls.capDescription: The MasterMinter owner can assign any controller to any minter; a controller can set an arbitrary per-minter allowance, and no global supply cap was found.
bypassSurfaces: The code-empty owner can designate itself or another address as a controller for any minter, then configure an arbitrary allowance without a timelock.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25526129 (hash 0xd2eca668433c517ab710c73c244a2545203f12b35a83e4fb521595be762bdc3f), the token returned this MasterMinter, getMinterManager() returned the EURC token, and owner() returned code-empty account 0xa1a083189c5425af0bc59a58b2f1649d5236871b. Circle's exact source lets that owner configure any controller/minter pair; the controller can then set any allowance. On-chain data does not establish MPC or HSM custody.

controls.label: Ethereum EURC token owner
controls.capDescription: The owner can replace masterMinter immediately; the replacement can authorize arbitrary minters and allowances.
bypassSurfaces: One signature can replace masterMinter and thereby create a new arbitrary mint path.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25526129 owner() returned this code-empty account. It can call updateMasterMinter without another signer or delay. The previously recorded 0x2c576cfc9612541eb827b5c52479f364ddfafeb7 was the pauser, not the custom proxy admin. On-chain data does not establish MPC or HSM custody.

controls.label: Solana EURC mint-authority multisig
controls.capDescription: Classic SPL Token mint authority; no supply cap or mint allowance is enforced.
bypassSurfaces: Two signers can mint an arbitrary amount or rotate the mint authority without a timelock.
controls.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 432714278 (block height 410782389, hash 2zmgf9eoeHxnc8cU4jzyYSRPi8RkxAXhPWutQwR9w9ZS), this immutable classic SPL Token multisig required 2 of 4 System Program signers: 72sDZqwuLudQU4U3osKjLFymnZ9CXQy7cJg8eJsBbe1W, 9a6NCvgcU2FQL2sQzKFG9Yn3Jd5Lke7L8b7BjjZTkKMm, 6AMkWisfJsN32ppCidNmYULECxRUaLhsNyoiYSbAhPD8, and CDntn7Ptn8fv68K3VeHFrGSJY6T2fdbtxEh4quuQmz27. All 5,667 later mint-address transactions through the audit endpoint were fetched with zero failures and contained no EURC setAuthority instruction, so current state projects back to the exact slot. Token Program ProgramData 3gvYRKWyXRR9xKWe1ZjPhLY5ZJRN7KDB4rFZFGoJfFk2 has null upgrade authority.

controls.label: Stellar EURC issuer multisig
controls.capDescription: The issuer can create arbitrary EURC units; Stellar assets have no protocol supply cap.
bypassSurfaces: Two signers can issue arbitrary units or change signers, thresholds, and authorization flags without a protocol timelock.
controls.evidence: At Stellar ledger 63463325 (hash abd18d4cad6e6a0baf1bd42f9f95f4657fae28ac2a773a98a2a7640438730a1), the issuer had last changed at ledger 63393006, before the cutoff. Its master weight was 0; external signers GAAJM2L6ERI3W3V3AICROSXNMBSZ3QMC4WG7ONE5HATYRYXF3KMI4E7A, GBO7BGBUE2SHSDVY3MS7GWNDCJ75J2EIS2P6TAVVHZDTYYNAJSYCFW5H, GC3LJ74JSWCH4QRJEV6AWQPVBTO7TSSKUPEMH3EIXDYFWHGQQPS4RS7O, and GCFP5OXXBEMUMZJFHA7KXKNYI6UKNWMKCPOLQQILCVLRR76MQCJU7MSV each had weight 1; low, medium, and high thresholds were 2.

controls.label: EURC deployment-wide EVM proxy admins
bypassSurfaces: Each code-empty chain-local proxy admin can replace its deployment's mint logic immediately through Circle's custom org.zeppelinos.proxy slots.
No EVM deployment exposes an on-chain multisig or timelock on the proxy-admin path.
controls.evidence: At the exact cutoff, custom implementation/admin slots were Ethereum 0x43506849d7c04f9138d1a2050bbf3a0c054402dd / 0x9ed85723c5c55b746eb2c4b7e2a359b2091b8fe7, Base 0x2ce6311ddae708829bc0784c967b7d77d19fd779 / 0x4fa3c7461ba47ff34d4033ebaa30525c939991e1, Avalanche 0x30dfe0469803bce76f8f62ac24b18d33d3d6ffe6 / 0x625c3d1e1cd9f515f90c3b472653f28d32765c22, World Chain 0x8378ae07072d24fc8f572fbce35700352d0aae6a / 0xf40086691722eec331624cd15f82c89b87b65e36, and Cronos 0x007f588ca3ffe53f20cb03553ca38bb13542ff89 / 0xbd13d015904514a5da1e2ee493a6fe15d0260785. EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots were zero on all five. Every custom admin was code-empty and could upgrade with one signature and no delay.

review.evidence: Exact-cutoff state at 2026-07-13T20:34:40Z was reconstructed from Ethereum block 25526129, Base block 48592766, Avalanche block 90233120, World Chain block 32319620, Cronos block 82569750, finalized Solana slot 432714278, and Stellar ledger 63463325. EVM token roles, MasterMinter managers and owners, custom implementation/admin slots, EIP-1967 and beacon slots, and code status were checked. The Ethereum storage-slot-1 value previously labeled as proxy admin was disproved: 0x2c576cfc9612541eb827b5c52479f364ddfafeb7 was the live pauser, while the custom proxy-admin slot held 0x9ed85723c5c55b746eb2c4b7e2a359b2091b8fe7. Solana mint-authority history was exhaustively checked after the cutoff, and the Stellar issuer state predates it. All seven native issuance deployments and every mint-critical code-replacement path are represented; off-chain custody behind code-empty/system accounts remains unknown.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: EURC uses Circle CCTP V2 native burn-and-mint transfers across supported networks including Ethereum, Avalanche, Base, and Solana, so durable cross-chain movement depends on Circle issuer-native mint/burn infrastructure rather than a third-party liquidity bridge.
